cats.name: 语法
cats.desc: be 动词、三单、There be、can、连词、序数词……

cats.name: 句型与交际
cats.desc: 问候、问路、问时间、购物等课本重点句型

points.title: 打招呼与自我介绍
points.explain:
见面问候：Hello! / Hi! / Good morning.
问好：How are you? — I'm fine, thank you. And you? / I'm great, thanks.
初次见面：Nice to meet you. — Nice to meet you too.
问名字：What's your name? — My name is … / I'm …
问拼写：How do you spell your name? — E-M-M-A, Emma.

examples.en: Good morning, Ms Gao.
examples.zh: 高老师，早上好。

examples.en: Nice to meet you too, Fu Xing!
examples.zh: 也很高兴见到你，付星！

examples.en: How do you spell your name?
examples.zh: 你的名字怎么拼写？

questions.q:
— Nice to meet you, Emma.
— ______
questions.e: 对方说 Nice to meet you，回答要加 too：Nice to meet you too.
questions.s:
— Nice to meet you, Emma.
— Nice to meet you too.

questions.q:
— How are you?
— ______
questions.e: How are you? 问身体/状况，回答 I'm fine, thank you. 或 I'm great, thanks.
questions.s:
— How are you?
— I'm fine, thank you.

questions.q:
— ______
— M-I-L-L-E-R, Miller.
o: How do you spell your name?
questions.e: 答语是逐个字母拼读，所以问的是 How do you spell your name?
questions.s:
— How do you spell your name?
— M-I-L-L-E-R, Miller.

questions.q:
— Good morning, class.
— ______
questions.e: 老师说 Good morning，学生用同样的问候回应：Good morning, Ms Gao.
questions.s:
— Good morning, class.
— Good morning, Ms Gao.

questions.e: 特殊疑问句：疑问词 What 开头，What's = What is。
questions.s: What's your name?

questions.a: How do you spell your name?
questions.e: How do you spell …? 你怎么拼写……？
questions.s: How do you spell your name?

questions.q:
— I'm fine, thank you. And ______?
— I'm great, thanks.
questions.e: And you? 你呢？用来反问对方。
questions.s:
— I'm fine, thank you. And you?
— I'm great, thanks.

points.title: 大小写与缩写
points.explain:
句子第一个字母要大写。
人名、地名的首字母要大写：Peter Brown, Beijing。
I（我）任何时候都大写。
缩写字母都用大写：PRC 中华人民共和国、UN 联合国、WHO 世界卫生组织。

examples.en: My name is Emma Miller.
examples.zh: 我的名字是埃玛·米勒。

examples.en: Helen and I are friends.
examples.zh: 海伦和我是朋友。

questions.q: 下面哪一句书写正确？
questions.e: 句首 My 大写，人名 Peter 大写，其余小写。
questions.s: My name is Peter.

questions.q: “联合国”的英文缩写是：
questions.e: UN = United Nations 联合国，缩写全部大写。
questions.s: UN

questions.q: WHO 表示：
questions.e: 全部大写的 WHO 是缩写，指世界卫生组织；小写 who 才是“谁”。

questions.q: 下面哪一句书写正确？
o: helen and i are in Class 1.
Helen and i are in class 1.
Helen and I are in Class 1.
helen and I are in class 1.
questions.e: 句首、人名 Helen、代词 I、班级 Class 1 都要大写。
questions.s: Helen and I are in Class 1.

questions.q: “中华人民共和国”的英文缩写：______
questions.e: PRC = People's Republic of China。
questions.s: PRC

points.title: 不定冠词 a / an
points.explain:
a / an 表示“一个”，只用在单数可数名词前。
看读音不看字母：以元音音素开头用 an，其他用 a。
an eraser, an apple, an orange, an egg；a ruler, a cap, a bottle, a key。

examples.en: I have an eraser and a ruler.
examples.zh: 我有一块橡皮和一把尺子。

questions.q: I have ______ eraser in my schoolbag.
questions.e: eraser /ɪˈreɪzə(r)/ 以元音音素开头，用 an。
questions.s: I have an eraser in my schoolbag.

questions.q: This is ______ bottle.
questions.e: bottle 以辅音 /b/ 开头，用 a。
questions.s: This is a bottle.

questions.q: I have ______ orange and ______ cap.
questions.e: orange 以元音开头用 an；cap 以辅音开头用 a。
questions.s: I have an orange and a cap.

questions.q: 下面哪个短语正确？
questions.e: key 是单数，以辅音开头，用 a key；复数 keys 前不能用 a/an。
questions.s: a key

questions.q: There is ______ egg on the desk.
questions.e: egg 以元音音素 /e/ 开头，用 an。
questions.s: There is an egg on the desk.

points.title: 名词复数（一）
points.explain:
一般加 -s：key → keys, pencil → pencils, ruler → rulers。
以 s, x, ch, sh 结尾加 -es：box → boxes, glass → glasses。
成双成对的东西常用复数：glasses 眼镜, shoes 鞋, socks 袜子, trousers 裤子。
复数作主语，be 动词用 are：The rulers are blue.

examples.en: What colour are the rulers? — They're blue.
examples.zh: 尺子是什么颜色？——蓝色。

questions.q: I have three ______.
questions.e: three 后接复数，key 直接加 -s。
questions.s: I have three keys.

questions.q: My ______ are under the bed.
questions.e: 动词用 are，主语是复数 shoes。
questions.s: My shoes are under the bed.

questions.q: There are two ______ (box) on the floor.
questions.e: box 以 x 结尾，加 -es。
questions.s: There are two boxes on the floor.

questions.q: Where are my ______ (glass)? — They're on your nose!
questions.e: glasses 眼镜，常用复数；glass 以 s 结尾加 -es。
questions.s: Where are my glasses? — They're on your nose!

questions.q:
— What colour ______ the trousers?
— They're black.
questions.e: trousers 是复数，用 are。
questions.s:
— What colour are the trousers?
— They're black.

points.title: 问物品、颜色和位置
points.explain:
问有什么：What do you have in your schoolbag? — I have a cap / some books.
问颜色：What colour is the cap? — It's red. / What colour are the rulers? — They're blue.
问位置：Where is my cap? — It's under your desk. / Some books are in / on / under the box.

examples.en: What do you have in your schoolbag?
examples.zh: 你的书包里有什么？

examples.en: Is it in your schoolbag? — No, it isn't.
examples.zh: 它在你书包里吗？——不在。

questions.q:
— ______ is your new cap?
— It's red.
questions.e: 答语是颜色，用 What colour 提问。
questions.s:
— What colour is your new cap?
— It's red.

questions.q:
— Where is my cap?
— It's ______ your desk.
questions.e: under 在……下面，回答位置用介词。
questions.s:
— Where is my cap?
— It's under your desk.

questions.q:
— Is the key in your schoolbag?
— No, it ______.
questions.e: Is …? 的否定回答：No, it isn't.
questions.s:
— Is the key in your schoolbag?
— No, it isn't.

questions.a: What do you have in your schoolbag?
questions.e: What do you have …? 你有什么……？
questions.s: What do you have in your schoolbag?

questions.e: pencils 是复数，用 are。
questions.s: What colour are the pencils?

points.title: this / that / these / those
points.explain:
近处单数 this（这个），近处复数 these（这些）。
远处单数 that（那个），远处复数 those（那些）。
What's this / that? — It's a cat.
What are these / those? — They're carrot plants.
注意回答时：this/that 用 it，these/those 用 they。

examples.en: What are these? — They're carrot plants.
examples.zh: 这些是什么？——是胡萝卜苗。

examples.en: What's that? — It's a goose.
examples.zh: 那是什么？——是一只鹅。

questions.q:
— What are ______ over there?
— They're apple trees.
questions.e: over there 远处，They're 复数，用 those。
questions.s:
— What are those over there?
— They're apple trees.

questions.q:
— What's this?
— ______ a rabbit.
questions.e: this 单数，回答用 It's。注意 It's 和 Its 不同。
questions.s:
— What's this?
— It's a rabbit.

questions.q:
— What are these?
— ______ baby chickens.
questions.e: these 复数，回答用 They're。
questions.s:
— What are these?
— They're baby chickens.

questions.q: ______ is my uncle's farm.
questions.e: is 单数，用 This。
questions.s: This is my uncle's farm.

questions.q: these 的单数形式是 ______
questions.e: this ↔ these；that ↔ those。
questions.s: this

points.title: How many 与名词复数（二）
points.explain:
How many + 可数名词复数 问数量：How many rabbits do they have? — Eight.
特殊复数要单独记：goose → geese, sheep → sheep, child → children。
以辅音 + o 结尾的部分名词加 -es：tomato → tomatoes, potato → potatoes。

examples.en: How many ducks does my uncle have?
examples.zh: 我叔叔有多少只鸭子？

questions.q: How many ______ can you see?
questions.e: How many 后接复数，goose 的复数是 geese。
questions.s: How many geese can you see?

questions.q:
— How many ______ does he have?
— Twelve.
questions.e: How many + 可数名词复数。
questions.s:
— How many rabbits does he have?
— Twelve.

questions.q: There are five ______ (sheep) on the farm.
questions.e: sheep 单复数同形。
questions.s: There are five sheep on the farm.

questions.q: I can see many ______ (tomato) plants.
questions.e: 名词作定语修饰 plants 时一般用单数：tomato plants。
questions.s: I can see many tomato plants.

questions.q: My grandpa has two ______ (potato) in his hands.
questions.e: potato 复数加 -es：potatoes。
questions.s: My grandpa has two potatoes in his hands.

points.title: 一般现在时（be）与人称代词
points.explain:
I 用 am；you / we / they 和复数用 are；he / she / it 和单数用 is。
缩写：I'm, you're, he's, she's, it's, we're, they're；isn't, aren't。
一般疑问句把 be 提前：Are you Peter? — Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
人称代词主格：I, you, he, she, it, we, they。

examples.en: Are Meimei and Peter in the same class? — Yes, they are.
examples.zh: 梅梅和彼得在同一个班吗？——是的。

examples.en: Where is Mr Smith from? — He's from the US.
examples.zh: 史密斯先生来自哪里？——他来自美国。

questions.q: Emma and Ella ______ twins.
questions.e: Emma and Ella 两个人，复数主语用 are。
questions.s: Emma and Ella are twins.

questions.q: Tom and I ______ in the same class.
questions.e: Tom and I 是复数，用 are（不要被 I 迷惑）。
questions.s: Tom and I are in the same class.

questions.q: Lin Hai's favourite colour ______ green.
questions.e: 主语是 colour（单数），用 is。
questions.s: Lin Hai's favourite colour is green.

questions.q:
— Are you Peter?
— No, ______.
questions.e: Are you …? 否定回答 No, I'm not.
questions.s:
— Are you Peter?
— No, I'm not.

questions.q: My sister ______ (be) 13 years old.
questions.e: my sister 单数第三人称，用 is。
questions.s: My sister is 13 years old.

questions.q: I ______ (be) from Chengdu, China.
questions.e: I 用 am。
questions.s: I am from Chengdu, China.

questions.q: This is my new friend. ______ name is Sally.
questions.e: 名词 name 前用形容词性物主代词；Sally 是女生，用 Her。
questions.s: This is my new friend. Her name is Sally.

points.title: 形容词性物主代词
points.explain:
物主代词表示“……的”，后面必须跟名词。
I → my, you → your, he → his, she → her, it → its, we → our, they → their。
容易混：he（他，作主语）和 his（他的）；it's（= it is）和 its（它的）。

examples.en: His name is Peter. He's from the UK.
examples.zh: 他的名字叫彼得，他来自英国。

questions.q: This is my friend. ______ name is Jim Green.
questions.e: name 前用 his（他的）。
questions.s: This is my friend. His name is Jim Green.

questions.q: I have a cat. ______ name is Mimi.
questions.e: its 它的；it's = it is。
questions.s: I have a cat. Its name is Mimi.

questions.q: Lucy and Lily are twins. ______ favourite food is hot pot.
questions.e: their 他们的/她们的；there 是“那里”。
questions.s: Lucy and Lily are twins. Their favourite food is hot pot.

questions.q:
— What's ______ (you) full name?
— Tom Smith.
questions.e: full name 前用 your（你的）。
questions.s:
— What's your full name?
— Tom Smith.

questions.q: We are in Class 2. ______ (we) class teacher is Ms Gao.
questions.e: 我们的 = our，句首大写 Our。
questions.s: We are in Class 2. Our class teacher is Ms Gao.

points.title: 人称代词宾格
points.explain:
放在动词或介词后面要用宾格：I → me, you → you, he → him, she → her, it → it, we → us, they → them。
like her, help me, play with them, tell us。

examples.en: Lisa's pet cat is very cute. She likes it very much.
examples.zh: 莉萨的宠物猫很可爱，她很喜欢它。

questions.q: Sally is my new classmate. I like ______ very much.
questions.e: like 后接宾格 her。
questions.s: Sally is my new classmate. I like her very much.

questions.q: Can you tell ______ your name?
questions.e: tell 后接宾格 us。
questions.s: Can you tell us your name?

questions.q: My grandparents are kind. I often visit ______.
questions.e: visit 后接宾格 them。
questions.s: My grandparents are kind. I often visit them.

questions.q: Peter is my friend. I often play tennis with ______ (he).
questions.e: 介词 with 后用宾格 him。
questions.s: Peter is my friend. I often play tennis with him.

points.title: 认识新朋友：问班级、来自哪里
points.explain:
What class are you in? — I'm in Class 1, Grade 7.（班级在前、年级在后，Class / Grade 和数字都大写）
Who's your class teacher? — It's Ms Gao.
Where are you from? — I'm from Sydney, Australia.
What's your full name? / first name / last name。
Would you like to be my friend? 你愿意做我的朋友吗？
in the same class 在同一个班。

examples.en: I'm in Class 1, Grade 7.
examples.zh: 我在七年级一班。

examples.en: Would you like to be my friend?
examples.zh: 你愿意做我的朋友吗？

questions.q: “七年级三班”的正确写法是：
questions.e: 英文先说小单位（班）再说大单位（年级），首字母大写：Class 3, Grade 7。
questions.s: Class 3, Grade 7

questions.q:
— ______ is your class teacher?
— It's Mr Wang.
questions.e: 问人用 Who。
questions.s:
— Who is your class teacher?
— It's Mr Wang.

questions.q:
— ______ is Sally from?
— She's from Australia.
questions.e: 问来自哪里用 Where … from?
questions.s:
— Where is Sally from?
— She's from Australia.

questions.q: Meimei and I are in ______ class.
questions.e: 固定搭配 the same，same 前要加 the。
questions.s: Meimei and I are in the same class.

questions.q: Would you like ______ my friend?
questions.e: would like to do 想要做某事。
questions.s: Would you like to be my friend?

questions.e: 问班级：What class are you in?
questions.s: What class are you in?

questions.q: My ______ name is Smith, and my first name is Tom.
questions.e: last name 姓；first name 名。
questions.s: My last name is Smith, and my first name is Tom.

points.title: 一般现在时（do）：动词三单
points.explain:
主语是 he / she / it 或单数名词时，动词要用第三人称单数形式。
一般加 -s：play → plays, like → likes。
以 s, x, ch, sh, o 结尾加 -es：watch → watches, go → goes, do → does。
辅音 + y 结尾，变 y 为 i 加 -es：study → studies。
特殊：have → has。

examples.en: Teng Fei's grandpa loves sport.
examples.zh: 滕飞的爷爷热爱运动。

examples.en: Teng Fei's father has many books.
examples.zh: 滕飞的爸爸有很多书。

questions.q: My brother ______ short hair.
questions.e: 主语 my brother 是三单，have 变 has。
questions.s: My brother has short hair.

questions.q: He often ______ us laugh.
questions.e: 主语 He，动词加 -s：makes。
questions.s: He often makes us laugh.

questions.q: Teng Fei and his grandpa ______ ping-pong every week.
questions.e: 主语是两个人（复数），动词用原形。
questions.s: Teng Fei and his grandpa play ping-pong every week.

questions.q: My sister really ______ (like) reading.
questions.e: my sister 三单，like 加 -s。
questions.s: My sister really likes reading.

questions.q: Lisa ______ (watch) TV with her parents on Sundays.
questions.e: watch 以 ch 结尾，加 -es。
questions.s: Lisa watches TV with her parents on Sundays.

questions.q: Tom ______ (study) English every day.
questions.e: 辅音 + y 结尾，变 y 为 i 再加 -es。
questions.s: Tom studies English every day.

points.title: 一般现在时：疑问句与否定句
points.explain:
疑问句借助 do / does：Do you play the piano? — Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
主语三单用 does，后面的动词变回原形：Does your father spend a lot of time reading? — Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.
否定句：I don't sing much. She doesn't like maths.

examples.en: Do you have any sisters or brothers?
examples.zh: 你有兄弟姐妹吗？

examples.en: Does your mother like music?
examples.zh: 你妈妈喜欢音乐吗？

questions.q:
— ______ your father play any sport?
— Yes, he does.
questions.e: 主语 your father 三单，用 Does 提问。
questions.s:
— Does your father play any sport?
— Yes, he does.

questions.q:
— Do you like music?
— No, I ______.
questions.e: Do you …? 否定回答 No, I don't.
questions.s:
— Do you like music?
— No, I don't.

questions.q: My mother ______ like coffee.
questions.e: 主语三单，否定用 doesn't + 动词原形。
questions.s: My mother doesn't like coffee.

questions.q: Does she ______ a pet dog?
questions.e: does 后面的动词用原形 have。
questions.s: Does she have a pet dog?

questions.a: Does your brother play the guitar?
questions.e: Does + 主语 + 动词原形 …?
questions.s: Does your brother play the guitar?

points.title: 名词所有格 's
points.explain:
单数名词加 's：Kate's cat, my uncle's farm。
以 -s 结尾的复数名词只加 '：my grandparents' caps, my brothers' balls。
不以 -s 结尾的复数加 's：Children's Day。
两人共有，只在后一个名字加 's：Peter and Emma's classroom。

examples.en: These are my grandparents' caps.
examples.zh: 这些是我祖父母的帽子。

examples.en: This is Peter and Emma's classroom.
examples.zh: 这是彼得和埃玛（共同）的教室。

questions.q: This is ______ cat. It is very cute.
questions.e: 单数名词加 's：Kate's。
questions.s: This is Kate's cat. It is very cute.

questions.q: These are my little ______ balls.
questions.e: 复数名词 brothers 以 s 结尾，只加 '。
questions.s: These are my little brothers' balls.

questions.q: June 1st is ______ Day.
questions.e: children 不以 s 结尾，加 's：Children's Day。
questions.s: June 1st is Children's Day.

questions.q: That is ______ (Teng Fei) schoolbag.
questions.e: 人名加 's 表示“……的”。
questions.s: That is Teng Fei's schoolbag.

points.title: like / love doing 与 a lot of
points.explain:
like / love 后接动词 -ing 表示爱好：like reading, love playing tennis。
-ing 变法：一般直接加 -ing；以不发音的 e 结尾去 e 加 -ing（make → making）；重读闭音节双写末尾字母（swim → swimming）。
a lot of / lots of 许多（可数、不可数都能用）；spend time (in) doing sth 花时间做某事。

examples.en: I also like playing tennis.
examples.zh: 我也喜欢打网球。

examples.en: My mum spends a lot of time reading.
examples.zh: 我妈妈花很多时间读书。

questions.q: My father likes ______ a lot.
questions.e: like doing 喜欢做某事。
questions.s: My father likes fishing a lot.

questions.q: She loves ______ (swim) in summer.
questions.e: swim 重读闭音节，双写 m 再加 -ing。
questions.s: She loves swimming in summer.

questions.q: My grandpa spends a lot of time ______ (read) newspapers.
questions.e: spend time doing sth 花时间做某事。
questions.s: My grandpa spends a lot of time reading newspapers.

questions.q: We have ______ fun together.
questions.e: fun 不可数，用 a lot of。
questions.s: We have a lot of fun together.

points.title: There be 句型
points.explain:
There is + 单数 / 不可数名词；There are + 复数名词，表示“某处有……”。
就近原则：be 跟最近的名词一致：There is a pen and two books.
一般疑问句：Is there a gym? — Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.
Are there any lockers? — Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.（疑问、否定句用 any）
There be 表示“某处存在”；have 表示“某人拥有”。

examples.en: There is a student centre between the library and the gym.
examples.zh: 图书馆和体育馆之间有一个学生中心。

examples.en: There are some trees in front of the sports field.
examples.zh: 运动场前面有一些树。

questions.q: There ______ a nice library behind the classroom building.
questions.e: a library 单数，用 There is。
questions.s: There is a nice library behind the classroom building.

questions.q: There ______ some pictures of famous people on the wall.
questions.e: pictures 复数，用 There are。
questions.s: There are some pictures of famous people on the wall.

questions.q:
— Is there a gym in this school?
— Yes, ______.
questions.e: Is there …? 回答 Yes, there is.
questions.s:
— Is there a gym in this school?
— Yes, there is.

questions.q:
— ______ any flowers in front of the building?
— No, there aren't.
questions.e: flowers 复数，用 Are there any …?
questions.s:
— Are there any flowers in front of the building?
— No, there aren't.

questions.q: There ______ a pen and two rulers on the desk.
questions.e: 就近原则：离 be 最近的是 a pen（单数），用 is。
questions.s: There is a pen and two rulers on the desk.

questions.q: There ______ (be) two lockers next to the reading corner.
questions.e: two lockers 复数，用 are。
questions.s: There are two lockers next to the reading corner.

points.title: 方位介词
points.explain:
in 在……里，on 在……上（表面接触），under 在……下面。
behind 在……后面，in front of 在……前面（外部）。
next to 紧挨着，between A and B 在 A 和 B 之间，across from 在……对面。
in the middle of 在……中间，at the back of 在……后部，in the corner 在角落里。

examples.en: The library is behind the classroom building.
examples.zh: 图书馆在教学楼后面。

examples.en: There is a teachers' building across from the school hall.
examples.zh: 礼堂对面有一栋教师楼。

questions.q: The school hall is ______ the classroom building and the science building.
questions.e: between A and B 在 A 和 B 之间。
questions.s: The school hall is between the classroom building and the science building.

questions.q: There's a screen ______ the wall.
questions.e: 挂在墙面上，用 on。
questions.s: There's a screen on the wall.

questions.q: The bookcases are next ______ the window.
questions.e: 固定搭配 next to 紧挨着。
questions.s: The bookcases are next to the window.

questions.q: The gym is across ______ the dining hall.
questions.e: 固定搭配 across from 在……对面。
questions.s: The gym is across from the dining hall.

questions.q: There are some trees in ______ of the sports field.
questions.e: in front of 在……前面。
questions.s: There are some trees in front of the sports field.

questions.q: My seat is in the ______ of the classroom.（在中间）
questions.e: in the middle of 在……中间。
questions.s: My seat is in the middle of the classroom.

points.title: 问地点：Where is / are …?
points.explain:
Where is the library? — It's behind the classroom building.
Where are the bookcases? — They're next to the window.
单数用 is / It's，复数用 are / They're。
写信结尾：Bye for now! / Yours, …

examples.en: Where are the lockers? — They're next to the reading corner.
examples.zh: 储物柜在哪里？——在阅读角旁边。

questions.q:
— Where ______ the lockers?
— ______ next to the reading corner.
questions.e: lockers 复数：are … They're。
questions.s:
— Where are the lockers?
— They're next to the reading corner.

questions.q:
— Where ______ the school hall?
— It's between the two buildings.
questions.e: the school hall 单数，用 is。
questions.s:
— Where is the school hall?
— It's between the two buildings.

questions.e: Where + be + 主语？
questions.s: Where is the library?

questions.q: My classroom is different ______ yours.
questions.e: be different from 与……不同。
questions.s: My classroom is different from yours.

points.title: 连词 and / but / because
points.explain:
and 补充同类信息（和；而且）：I have art and geography today.
but 表示转折（但是）：Biology is difficult but important.
because 说明原因（因为），回答 Why 的问题：I like Chinese because it's fun.
注意：中文“因为……所以……”在英语里不能 because 和 so 连用。

examples.en: History is my favourite subject, but my sister doesn't like it.
examples.zh: 历史是我最喜欢的科目，但是我妹妹不喜欢。

examples.en: He doesn't like maths because it's boring to him.
examples.zh: 他不喜欢数学，因为对他来说很无聊。

questions.q: I'm not good at science, ______ I like the class very much.
questions.e: 前后意思相反（不擅长 ↔ 很喜欢），用 but。
questions.s: I'm not good at science, but I like the class very much.

questions.q: I love Thursday afternoons ______ we have a fun class then.
questions.e: 后半句说明原因，用 because。
questions.s: I love Thursday afternoons because we have a fun class then.

questions.q: We learn about different plants ______ animals.
questions.e: 并列两个同类事物，用 and。
questions.s: We learn about different plants and animals.

questions.q:
— Why do you like geography?
— ______ I like travelling.
questions.e: Why 问原因，用 Because 回答。
questions.s:
— Why do you like geography?
— Because I like travelling.

questions.q: Biology is difficult ______ important.（困难但是重要）
questions.e: 转折用 but。
questions.s: Biology is difficult but important.

questions.q: She's my favourite teacher ______ she makes everyone feel special.
questions.e: 说明原因用 because。
questions.s: She's my favourite teacher because she makes everyone feel special.

points.title: 谈论科目与理由
points.explain:
What's your favourite subject? — My favourite subject is history.
Why do you like it? — Because it's interesting / useful / exciting.
be good at 擅长；be good with numbers 擅长和数字打交道。
help sb with sth 在某方面帮助某人：He often helps me with my English.
work out 算出；解决。

examples.en: He is good at English, and he often helps me with my English.
examples.zh: 他英语很好，经常帮我学英语。

questions.q: Binbin is good ______ maths.
questions.e: be good at 擅长。
questions.s: Binbin is good at maths.

questions.q: He often helps me ______ my English.
questions.e: help sb with sth 在某方面帮助某人。
questions.s: He often helps me with my English.

questions.q:
— ______ do you like IT?
— Because it's fun to learn to use computers.
questions.e: 答语 Because …，问原因用 Why。
questions.s:
— Why do you like IT?
— Because it's fun to learn to use computers.

questions.e: 问最喜欢的科目。
questions.s: What is your favourite subject?

questions.q: Can you help me ______ out this maths problem?
questions.e: work out 算出；解决。
questions.s: Can you help me work out this maths problem?

points.kp: 情态动词后接动词原形
points.title: 情态动词 can（能力）
points.explain:
can + 动词原形，表示“能，会”，没有人称和数的变化：He can swim.（不是 cans / swims）
否定：can't / cannot：I can't swim.
疑问把 can 提前：Can you play ping-pong? — Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
play + 球类不加 the：play chess, play ping-pong；play + 乐器加 the：play the violin, play the guitar。

examples.en: Emma can sing well, but she can't play any musical instruments.
examples.zh: 埃玛唱歌很好，但她不会演奏任何乐器。

examples.en: Can he play the violin? — Yes, he can.
examples.zh: 他会拉小提琴吗？——会。

questions.q: Linda can ______ English, French, and even some Chinese.
questions.e: can 后接动词原形。
questions.s: Linda can speak English, French, and even some Chinese.

questions.q:
— Can you play the guitar?
— No, I ______.
questions.e: Can you …? 否定回答 No, I can't.
questions.s:
— Can you play the guitar?
— No, I can't.

questions.q: My brother can play ______ violin, and he can play ______ chess too.
questions.e: 乐器前加 the，棋类、球类前不加冠词。
questions.s: My brother can play the violin, and he can play chess too.

questions.q: She ______ make delicious cakes!
questions.e: can 没有人称变化，也不加 to。
questions.s: She can make delicious cakes!

questions.q: A fish can ______ (swim), but it can't walk.
questions.e: can 后接动词原形 swim。
questions.s: A fish can swim, but it can't walk.

questions.e: Can + 主语 + 动词原形 …?
questions.s: Can you play ping-pong?

points.title: 加入社团：want to / would like to
points.explain:
What club do you want to join? — I want to join the music club.
want to do / would like to do 想做某事。
be interested in (doing) sth 对……感兴趣。
fall in love with 爱上；more than 多于。

examples.en: I want to join the drama club because I like acting.
examples.zh: 我想加入戏剧社，因为我喜欢表演。

examples.en: He is interested in nature.
examples.zh: 他对大自然感兴趣。

questions.q: I want ______ the art club.
questions.e: want to do 想做某事。
questions.s: I want to join the art club.

questions.q: Mike is interested ______ collecting insects.
questions.e: be interested in 对……感兴趣。
questions.s: Mike is interested in collecting insects.

questions.q:
— ______ club do you want to join?
— The chess club.
questions.e: What club 什么社团。
questions.s:
— What club do you want to join?
— The chess club.

questions.q: She would like ______ (learn) French.
questions.e: would like to do 想要做某事。
questions.s: She would like to learn French.

points.title: 时间表达与时间介词
points.explain:
at + 钟点：at 6:30, at about 10:00；at night, at weekends。
on + 某一天 / 某天上午等：on Monday, on Saturdays, on Sunday mornings。
in + 一天的某段 / 月 / 年：in the morning, in the afternoon。
钟点读法：6:30 six thirty / half past six；6:15 a quarter past six；6:45 a quarter to seven。
a.m. 上午，p.m. 下午。

examples.en: I usually get up at 6:30 a.m.
examples.zh: 我通常早上 6 点半起床。

examples.en: They go to the music club on Monday afternoons.
examples.zh: 他们周一下午去音乐社。

questions.q: He usually goes to bed ______ 9:30 p.m.
questions.e: 具体钟点前用 at。
questions.s: He usually goes to bed at 9:30 p.m.

questions.q: David plays basketball ______ Thursdays.
questions.e: 星期几前用 on。
questions.s: David plays basketball on Thursdays.

questions.q: Sam often helps his mother ______ Sunday mornings.
questions.e: 具体某一天的上午（Sunday mornings）用 on。
questions.s: Sam often helps his mother on Sunday mornings.

questions.q: I do my homework ______ the evening.
questions.e: in the morning / afternoon / evening。
questions.s: I do my homework in the evening.

questions.q: 7:15 可以读作：
questions.e: 15 分是 a quarter，过了 7 点用 past：a quarter past seven。
questions.s: a quarter past seven

questions.q: What do you usually do ______ weekends?
questions.e: at weekends（英式）/ on weekends（美式），课本用 at weekends。
questions.s: What do you usually do at weekends?

points.title: What time / When / What 问日常
points.explain:
What time 问具体钟点：What time do you usually get up? — At 6:30.
When 问时间（钟点、星期、日期都可以）：When does Lisa do her homework? — After dinner.
What 问做什么：What do you do after dinner?
主语三单用 does，动词变原形：What time does Tom go to bed?

examples.en: What does Peter do before breakfast? — He brushes his teeth and takes a shower.
examples.zh: 彼得早饭前做什么？——刷牙、洗澡。

questions.q:
— ______ does Tom usually go to bed?
— He usually goes to bed at 9:30 p.m.
questions.e: 答语是具体钟点，用 What time。
questions.s:
— What time does Tom usually go to bed?
— He usually goes to bed at 9:30 p.m.

questions.q:
— ______ do you do after dinner?
— I read books or do my homework.
questions.e: 问做什么，用 What。
questions.s:
— What do you do after dinner?
— I read books or do my homework.

questions.q:
— ______ is your maths class?
— On Monday.
questions.e: 答语是星期，用 When。
questions.s:
— When is your maths class?
— On Monday.

questions.q: What time ______ Mike usually get to school?
questions.e: 主语 Mike 三单，用 does。
questions.s: What time does Mike usually get to school?

questions.a: What time do you usually get up?
questions.e: 频度副词 usually 放在实义动词前。
questions.s: What time do you usually get up?

points.title: 日常作息与动词三单
points.explain:
get up → gets up, go → goes, do → does, brush → brushes, watch → watches, have → has。
频度副词 always > usually > often > sometimes > never，一般放在实义动词前、be 动词后。
常用短语：take a shower, brush teeth, get dressed, be on duty, go to bed。

examples.en: On Saturdays, Sam sometimes gets up at 9:00.
examples.zh: 周六萨姆有时 9 点起床。

questions.q: He usually ______ (go) to bed at about 10:00.
questions.e: go 以 o 结尾，三单加 -es。
questions.s: He usually goes to bed at about 10:00.

questions.q: Peter ______ (brush) his teeth before breakfast.
questions.e: brush 以 sh 结尾，加 -es。
questions.s: Peter brushes his teeth before breakfast.

questions.q: He makes breakfast and then ______ (do) his homework.
questions.e: do 三单 does。
questions.s: He makes breakfast and then does his homework.

questions.q: My father ______ late.
questions.e: 频度副词放实义动词前；主语三单用 gets。
questions.s: My father usually gets up late.

questions.q: I'm ______ duty today, so I go to school early.
questions.e: be on duty 值班。
questions.s: I'm on duty today, so I go to school early.

points.title: 序数词与日期
points.explain:
first, second, third 三个特殊；其余一般加 -th：fourth, sixth, seventh。
特殊变化：five → fifth, eight → eighth, nine → ninth, twelve → twelfth。
以 -ty 结尾，变 y 为 ie 再加 -th：twenty → twentieth。
几十几只变个位：twenty-one → twenty-first。
日期：When is your birthday? — It's on 2nd August. / on 15th July（具体某天用 on）。

examples.en: When is your birthday? — It's on 2nd August.
examples.zh: 你的生日是什么时候？——8月2日。

examples.en: We celebrate International Nurses Day on 12th May.
examples.zh: 我们在5月12日庆祝国际护士节。

questions.q: five 的序数词：______
questions.e: five → fifth（ve 变 f 加 th）。
questions.s: fifth

questions.q: twelve 的序数词：______
questions.e: twelve → twelfth。
questions.s: twelfth

questions.q: nine 的序数词：______
questions.e: nine → ninth（去 e 加 th）。
questions.s: ninth

questions.q: twenty 的序数词：______
questions.e: -ty 变 -tieth：twentieth。
questions.s: twentieth

questions.q: My birthday is ______ 3rd March.
questions.e: 具体某一天用 on。
questions.s: My birthday is on 3rd March.

questions.q: “第二十一”是：
questions.e: 几十几只变个位：twenty-first。
questions.s: twenty-first

questions.q: This is my ______ time to visit Beijing.
questions.e: 表示“第一次”用序数词 first。
questions.s: This is my first time to visit Beijing.

points.title: 购物：How much / How many
points.explain:
How much 问价格：How much are those oranges? — Six yuan a kilo.
How many + 可数名词复数 问数量：How many kilos do you want? — Five kilos.
How much + 不可数名词 问数量：How much milk do you want?
How old 问年龄：How old are you? — I'm 12.

examples.en: How much are those oranges? — Six yuan a kilo.
examples.zh: 那些橙子多少钱？——一公斤六元。

questions.q:
— ______ is the birthday card?
— 5 yuan.
questions.e: 问价格用 How much。
questions.s:
— How much is the birthday card?
— 5 yuan.

questions.q:
— ______ balloons do you want?
— I want ten.
questions.e: balloons 可数复数，问数量用 How many。
questions.s:
— How many balloons do you want?
— I want ten.

questions.q:
— ______ is your father?
— He's 45 years old.
questions.e: 问年龄用 How old。
questions.s:
— How old is your father?
— He's 45 years old.

questions.q: How much ______ those apples?
questions.e: 主语 those apples 复数，用 are。
questions.s: How much are those apples?

questions.a: How many kilos do you want?
questions.e: How many + 复数名词 + do you want?
questions.s: How many kilos do you want?

points.title: 特殊疑问词复习
points.explain:
what 什么，when 什么时候，where 哪里，who 谁，why 为什么，
how old 多大，how many 多少（可数），how much 多少钱 / 多少（不可数），what time 几点。
看答语找疑问词：答语说地点 → Where；说原因 → Why；说人 → Who / With whom。

examples.en: Who do you celebrate your birthday with? — With my parents.
examples.zh: 你和谁一起过生日？——和我父母。

examples.en: Why do people eat birthday noodles? — To wish for a long life.
examples.zh: 人们为什么吃长寿面？——为了祝愿长寿。

questions.q:
— ______ is Mrs Green from?
— She's from Australia.
questions.e: 问来自哪里用 Where。
questions.s:
— Where is Mrs Green from?
— She's from Australia.

questions.q:
— ______ do people eat birthday noodles?
— To wish for a long life.
questions.e: 答语说目的/原因，用 Why。
questions.s:
— Why do people eat birthday noodles?
— To wish for a long life.

questions.q:
— ______ do you want for a birthday gift?
— A new pair of shoes.
questions.e: 问想要什么，用 What。
questions.s:
— What do you want for a birthday gift?
— A new pair of shoes.

questions.q:
— ______ is China's National Day?
— It's on 1st October.
questions.e: 答语是日期，用 When。
questions.s:
— When is China's National Day?
— It's on 1st October.

questions.q:
— ______ do you celebrate your birthday with?
— With my parents.
questions.e: 问和谁一起，用 Who … with?
questions.s:
— Who do you celebrate your birthday with?
— With my parents.
